subject: Software Engineering
moduleTitle: Unit 3 — Linked List Data Structure and Its Applications
moduleDescription: In-depth study of pointer-linked dynamic data structures: Singly Linked Lists, splice invariants, pointer loss anti-patterns, Doubly Linked Lists, Sentinel (Dummy) Node patterns, Circular Linked Lists, Floyd's Cycle-Finding Algorithm (Tortoise and Hare), and LRU cache production architectures.
